outro: Kujo. Trust at the speed of AI. Install Kujo Hermes today.

scenes.title: A coupon should save money.
scenes.text: This checkout overcharges a customer by five dollars and ninety-nine cents. Let’s ask Hermes to find the cause, with Kujo checking the work.

scenes.title: Two commands to connect.
scenes.text: With Hermes, Kujo, and Git installed, add the plugin and run setup. Accept the prompts, then start a new conversation.

scenes.title: Define the expected result.
scenes.text: Spec validates the task contract. Here, free shipping depends on the original cart total. Hermes asks for approval before Eval runs repository checks.

scenes.title:
Expected $45.00.
Charged $50.99.
scenes.text: Eval runs the real tests. Two pass. One fails. The receipt records the overcharge and the exact command, so the failure can be reproduced.

scenes.title: Hermes fixes the cause.
scenes.text: A free local Qwen model, running inside Hermes, changes the shipping calculation. The tests stay unchanged.

scenes.title: All three checks pass.
scenes.text: Hermes runs the same Eval suite again. All three checks pass. That verifies this behavior, not every possible checkout scenario.

scenes.title: Keep the evidence.
scenes.text: Both receipts remain available. You can trace the commands and check the evidence hashes after the conversation ends.

scenes.title: More tools. Same conversation.
scenes.text: Discover tools for release review, repository inspection, and context preparation. ShipCheck, Scout, and PackWrite give Hermes more ways to support your development workflow.
